mechanism: Cenobamate is a moderate CYP3A4/2C19 inhibitor that increases primidone concentrations, while primidone induces CYP3A4 potentially reducing cenobamate efficacy; additive CNS depression and seizure threshold effects create pharmacodynamic conflict.
action: Monitor primidone levels closely; consider primidone dose reduction when adding cenobamate; assess seizure control and CNS side effects regularly; therapeutic drug monitoring recommended.
